resources.string: Manage file mappings and import local JSON or XML plist grammars

One exact file name or *.extension per line. Java, Kotlin and other existing semantic languages stay protected.
The existing grammar scope or selected file mappings will be replaced. Other settings and built-in assets are kept.

Remove this external grammar? Its own mappings are removed only when no built-in grammar replaces it.
Refresh the current project (%1$s) to register changed file types? This uses the normal project reload and dependency checks.

Import only grammars you trust. Regex engines differ; not every TextMate/VS Code grammar is compatible, and time budgets cannot forcibly stop every slow regex. Imports are copied into app-private storage, not into your project or built-in assets. Unknown includes never trigger a download. Root switches affect file highlighting, not includes used by another grammar. The existing global TextMate switch still applies. Saving does not reload the project automatically.

Supported: UTF-8 JSON and XML plist (not binary plist, YAML or ZIP). Input ≤512 KiB; canonical grammar ≤1 MiB; 32 external grammars, 256 mappings and 8 MiB stored grammar data. Preview: ≤4096 characters, 20 lines, 512 characters per line; soft 1-second budget. Configuration conflicts never overwrite newer changes.
The process was restarted. Reselect the grammar file to rebuild the unsaved preview.
